name: Fort Worth Regional Distribution Center - Fort Worth TX

fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck driveways enter the site from the perimeter industrial road on the SW (Transport Dr side) and around the building with no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint. Street View (Sep 2025) of the truck roads shows wide-open paved driveways with no control. Open site.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at any truck entrance. The dark elongated structure beside the SW driveway in z20 imagery is a parked trailer/container, not a guard booth.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building with continuous dock banks on both the east and west long faces - shipping and receiving run from physically separate dock clusters on opposite building faces.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous bank of dock doors along both ~430m long faces; ~95 trailers backed in across the imagery, total doors well over 100 -> 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large paved drop yards flank both long faces with many trailers parked without tractors; capacity 50+.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide paved truck yards and multiple wide open driveways - ample room for express/bypass lanes if a gate were added.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Open multi-tenant park roads; lane counts approximate from imagery.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimate from perimeter box covering the building and both truck yards; vacant land to the north excluded.
